summary: Built retro HUD design system mockups (tokens.css, components.css, demo.js, 6 pages) in features/design-theme/. Three surface families, md-archive prose, separate mobile layout. Verified at 375px and 1280px. Recorded decisions 001 and 002, wrote Phase 1 Angular setup handoff brief.

Generated the Angular 22 workspace at the repo root (zoneless, standalone, strict, prefix joo) and built the foundation in 13 steps: schematic naming defaults with type suffixes, pinned toolchain (Node 24, pnpm, TypeScript ~6.0.3), extra strictness, static prerendering (outputMode static, no server), cascade-layer styles pipeline with static data-theme=retro, angular-eslint + Prettier + import-direction rules generated from the src/app folder list via built-in no-restricted-imports, @ngrx/signals ~22.0.1 installed (no store code yet), Vitest browser mode with a reference hybrid Act/Wait/Assert spec, build budgets from the measured baseline, a Node-built-ins-only static server script, and .mcp.json agent tooling. Paper trail: decisions 003-010, first full ARCHITECTURE.md, area CONTEXT.md files, engineering guidelines doc, plan deviations section.

Built the design system pages are composed from, in 18 task commits. Nine token-driven component sub-groups under src/app/shared/design-system/ (actions, data-display, form-controls, indicators, navigation, page-layouts, surfaces, typography) plus a page-templates/ sub-group holding four slot-only shells; app-shell/ holds the three chrome parts. Solved widgets come from PrimeNG 22.1, skinned through a definePreset preset onto our semantic tokens with cascade-layer ordering and mapped zIndex tiers (decision 011). All of it renders in a dev-only /specimen route, which is both the parts kit and the verification surface. Zoneless, strict, signal APIs only, plain CSS reading semantic tokens only. Hybrid interaction tests for the five named interactive targets; no component harness was earned (decision 008 makes one optional). The whole-branch review parked two findings to BACKLOG.md rather than fixing them: the record-grid mobile card layout is keyed to consumer field names, and three design tokens plus two ELEVATION entries go unread. The run also cost far more than it should have; its causes and their fixes are in _architecture/workflow-friction-log.md, and decision 016 moves durable tracking out of the harness ledger and into the paper trail.

Initial bundle 1.31 MB to 536 kB raw (130 kB transferred). Home route lazy; record-grid replaced p-table with a plain table; shell source count read after first render; budgets re-set (initial 600/750 kB, anyScript 700 kB/1 MB, anyComponentStyle 4/8 kB); learn/:topic set to client render to fix the prerender error; 51 dead ChangeDetectionStrategy imports removed; specimen virtual demo removed. Added lighthouse devDependency, ux:lab record/compare/strict with committed per-commit baselines, build --stats-json, brotli + index.html serving in serve-static-build, .github/workflows/ci.yml. Decisions 032 and 033. Lab above target: /search TBT ~780 ms, LCP 4.4 to 5.2 s on / and docs (BACKLOG).
